messages.author: a70102b7393f797f
messages.subject: Shinyapps - Data not loading
parts:
Hello,
I have an app in shinyapps that usually worked, so I made some updates and deployed it again.
But it seems that it is not loading the data perfectly.

I'm using the command "save.image (" ... /. Rdata ")" to save my data, as I always did. Some
tables are loadings and others not. My updates are not related to tables not loaded.


My app is in https://psuantt.shinyapps.io/resultado/

Could the Shinyapps team help me??

Thank you so much!

Luis

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Shinyapps - Data not loading
parts:
Hi Luis,
The storage on shinyapps.io is not guaranteed to be the same storage on every start of the application.  Here is an article that talks a bit about it.

http://shiny.rstudio.com/articles/share-data.html

We will likely need to provide a solution for folks who need it, but is likely something we won't tackle until we have launched the service.

-Tareef
